findings.reason: The Informatics route profile now uses the existing compiled-jurisdiction mode. The existing actual source compiler supplies each country, national views are evaluated separately in each supported country, and fixed-country views remain fixed. A national union no longer masks countries with no actual terminal offer. No authored view, role or membership is invented.

Expected Informatics terminals now use the same existing goalMatchesFilters predicate for authored course/duration that already filters the visible scope. GK no longer demands an LK-only whole exam and vice versa. Empty applicable endpoint sets still fail; this is not a goal-coverage subset pass.

Optional readonly compositionViewFiles permits the direct native evaluator to read six small temporary fixtures. Omission follows exactly the old production discovery expression. Exporting the existing profile/evaluator and importing the test adds no alternate projection or scope derivation.

The complete new test was read. It uses current-source goal identities but explicitly labels the modified skill graph with six goals as a fixture. National country splitting, exact course endpoints, missing country/course endpoints, empty expected sets and missing compiled binding are checked through native evaluation. CQR203 remains warn and exact endpoint matching does not promote beyond M3; empty/missing endpoint scopes stay M2. The before/country-only/final exits 1/1/0 are real author executions, not new executions by this reviewer.

Independently decoded and compared the full original twelve-profile before/after result objects: eleven complete profiles are exactly equal, and every non-CQR104 Informatics rule is exactly equal. Recounted all48 unique view/country pairs:42 empty failures and6 passes, no missing or unexpected terminal sets. Source/view/code hashes in the bound original evidence match the current files.

limitations: The retained42 empty contexts are real unresolved data/offer failures; this code review does not certify Informatics M6.
The evidence comparison validates saved actual runs and current input hashes, not a new producer run.
No new exam task, coverage, country assignment, course identity, GK24/E25 candidate, master-result meaning or learning unit is approved.
Current authored Informatics course cases are covered; a novel duration profile would need its own concrete source fixture. The existing duration predicate is reused unchanged.
